hypotheses.title: The committed M2/M5 benchmark baseline is stale: the bench gate is red at the program base SHA on unchanged product code, with 8 comparison failures whose magnitudes are the alpha.15 card-cache win
evidence: GoTavern bench profiles run 42160109620 (workflow_dispatch at c8472c1), job bench-profiles-linux-amd64, step 'Run benchmarks, capture profiles, compare to the committed baseline' -> FAILURE

the run's comparison table: BenchmarkCharactersAllScale/cards_100_640KB_image ns/op -84.3% / B/op -78.4%; cards_100_128KB_image -72.8% / -57.0%; cards_1000_32KB_image -64.6% / -34.7%; ChatCompletionAssemble/scaled_1MB -63.5%; ChatCompletionMarshal/scaled_1MB -66.4%
tests/perf/bench-baseline.txt header: recordedAt 2026-11-04T03:56:01Z, commit ed75eee (2026-11-03T19:55), runnerImage ubuntu26
git cat-file -e ed75eee:internal/server/characters_card_cache.go -> 128 (the baseline tree predates the cache)
cc72384 'perf(characters): identity-keyed card-text cache for /api/characters/all' is 2026-11-05T02:07 and is an ancestor of main (git merge-base --is-ancestor cc72384 main exit 0)

47da1de (2026-11-05) removed BenchmarkCharactersAllScaleColdFirstRequest 'to keep the committed-baseline gate green' and said 'no scheduled gate is left red'; the warm rows themselves had moved, so the message's premise was false
gh run list --workflow=bench-profiles.yml: the last run before 42160109620 was 2026-11-04; the workflow triggers on a Tuesday cron + dispatch, so alpha.15 shipped without a post-cache run
scripts/bench-profiles.mjs:338-346 deliberately excludes runnerImageVersion from HOST_FACT_KEYS
docs/release-manifest.json: 'GoTavern bench profiles' is NOT a required gate; 'GoTavern smoke metrics' is
hypotheses.reproducerPlan: Already observed: dispatch bench-profiles.yml at a SHA whose product code is f1396ce. The eight failures are the observation. The deliberate repair is a baseline regeneration on the Linux runner with the cache in the tree (node scripts/bench-profiles.mjs --update-baseline --out-dir tests/perf/out), committed together with its raw run, followed by a green comparison; it must NOT be done as an M0 read-only action.
hypotheses.counterargument: The speedups are legitimate: the cache really does remove repeat-serve allocations, so the code is not wrong and a naive 'fix the code' would be the wrong repair. The defect is the stale gate input plus the claim in 47da1de that no gate was left red. It is nevertheless a confirmed defect of the evidence machinery, not of the product: M5's before/after cannot cite this comparator until the baseline is regenerated, and alpha.15's M2 performance-evidence claim rested on a gate that was not run at its release SHA.

hypotheses.title: The M0 resource baseline has no server-process profile: smoke metrics records RSS and latency but no heap/block/mutex/CPU pprof of the running server, and the bench profiles are in-process
evidence: scripts/smoke-metrics.mjs measures coldStartToVersionMs, warmStartToVersionMs, latency.*, freshInstall.files/bytes, memory.*.rssBytes and install.*
the only pprof capture is bench-profiles (in-process test binary): scripts/bench-profiles.mjs:431-460
grep for /debug/pprof across internal/: 0 hits (Lane E independent count)
docs/perf-baseline.md:111 says pprof capture is missing while bench-profiles captures it (Lane E H12)
hypotheses.reproducerPlan: M5's 30-60 minute soak needs a server-process heap/goroutine/FD profile at intervals; add a gated pprof seam (or a separate profile harness) and record it with provenance. Until then M5 can report latency/RSS only.
hypotheses.counterargument: The in-process benches cover the allocation-heavy routes and smoke-metrics covers RSS; a server-process profile is a means, not a contract. It becomes load-bearing only if M5 claims a heap/goroutine-leak result.

hypotheses.title: The five strongest candidates, after independent Lead verification: three provider-wire config defects (D-H1, D-H2, D-H3), one data-safety migration gap (B-H3), and the stale benchmark baseline (L-H1)
evidence: D-H1 verified: internal/server/pinned_chat_config.go:35-45 derives the config file only from <dataRoot> and its parent; internal/commandline/paths.go:101-115 resolves an explicit --configPath; internal/app/server.go:158-173 says the explicit path wins; ../SillyTavern/src/util.js:44-79 resolves getConfigValue from the CONFIG_PATH chosen at startup. A --configPath launch therefore reaches provider-visible config keys as defaults.

D-H2 verified: internal/server/google_chat.go:33-34 names the gap, :67-68 returns a constant, :200/:453 consume it; ../SillyTavern/src/endpoints/backends/chat-completions.js:679/:1911 read gemini.apiVersion; docs/config-parity.md:89 classifies it 'implemented' with a test that only asserts URL shapes.

D-H3 verified: Select-String over internal/**/*.go for enableAdaptiveThinking returns only two comment lines (claude_chat.go:76, :119); ../SillyTavern/src/endpoints/backends/chat-completions.js:112 reads it, :260 gates the 4-6 generation with it; ../SillyTavern/default/config.yaml:376 ships enableAdaptiveThinking: false. Go hardcodes the JS default (true), so a stock install diverges for claude-opus-4-6/sonnet-4-6.

B-H3 verified: internal/migrate/migrate.go:432-436 puts only config.yaml and data in Conflicts; :221-230 copies certs and the third-party overlay with copyTree into the destination; :191-209 backs up Conflicts only. A dest that already has certs/overlay loses them silently under --force.
L-H1 verified in this fragment (run id, baseline commit, cache ancestry).
hypotheses.reproducer: NONE for the union; each row's own reproducerPlan names the one scenario needed
hypotheses.reproducerPlan: D-H1: boot with --configPath elsewhere/config.yaml carrying requestOverrides, drive one chat completion, assert the peer received the override header. D-H2: a provider-wire scenario with backendConfig gemini.apiVersion v1, compare rawTarget. D-H3: a provider-wire scenario with claude-sonnet-4-6 and the stock config; pinned sends budget_tokens, Go sends the effort string. B-H3: pre-create dest/certs/server.pem, run migrate --force, assert the cert bytes survive. L-H1: already observed (run 42160109620).
hypotheses.counterargument: None of the five is a data-loss or crash defect in the default install: D-H2's default equals the pinned default, D-H1 needs an explicit flag, D-H3 needs a 4-6 model, B-H3 needs an unusual destination shape, L-H1 is evidence machinery. They rank highest because each is source-proven, has a small discriminating reproducer, and defeats a claim the product currently makes (config-parity 'implemented', provider-wire equality, migration safety, M5 baseline).

refactorCandidates.candidate: immutable nested configuration options instead of the ~60-field flat HTTPHandlerOptions
refactorCandidates.evidenceFor: one translation function internal/server/http.go:140-240 mixes optionBoolean/optionNumber/defaults; 9 fallback defaults differ from pinned (D-H10); the config path is resolved twice (commandline and the chat-path heuristic, D-H1)
refactorCandidates.evidenceAgainst: no measured defect in the default launch path; the translation is already centralized in ONE function and its truthiness rules are tested; a nesting rewrite is not move-only and touches every handler construction
refactorCandidates.leadDisposition: DECLINE unless a red test from D-H1/D-H10 justifies it; keep the flat struct as a documented boundary

refactorCandidates.candidate: per-user runtime coordinator for settings saves, backup timers and child git processes
refactorCandidates.evidenceFor: settingsSaveMu is process-global and held across disk persistence (settings_save.go:50-87); a pending time.AfterFunc backup is not drained on shutdown; extensions_git uses context.Background with a 5-minute wall clock
refactorCandidates.evidenceAgainst: pinned is a single-threaded event loop, so cross-user serialization is not observably different in the simple case; no reproducer of lost state; a generic coordinator is exactly the indirection GOAL.md 15.4 warns about
refactorCandidates.leadDisposition: HOLD until Lane C's contention/shutdown evidence is complete; prefer a per-user map change over a scheduler

refactorCandidates.candidate: route every mutating route through the shared startup write layer
refactorCandidates.evidenceFor: 37/56 writers already use the data-root flock + atomicReplace; B-H4 names two recursive destructive routes outside the lock; B-H3 names migrate conflicts
refactorCandidates.evidenceAgainst: avatars/images are deliberately atomic-unlocked; the atomic-write core is on the do-not-rewrite list; no completed dangling-write or corruption reproducer yet
refactorCandidates.leadDisposition: HOLD; the actionable part is the two destructive routes (B-H4), which is a bounded fix, not an extraction

refactorCandidates.candidate: request-scoped cancellation for extension git and other child processes
refactorCandidates.evidenceFor: extensions_git.go:56-95 detaches from the request context; a cancelled browser action leaves git running up to five minutes
refactorCandidates.evidenceAgainst: pinned's simple-git path also has no abort and uses the same 5-minute block timeout (pinnedGitBlockTimeout mirrors extensions.js:17), so request-scoping would be safer-but-different and needs a product decision
refactorCandidates.leadDisposition: DECLINE as parity; if kept, it is a product decision that must change the compatibility claim

refactorCandidates.candidate: one cache framework for the identity-keyed caches
refactorCandidates.evidenceFor: three identity-keyed caches (accounts, settings/user-metadata, card text) share a key model and invalidation rule
refactorCandidates.evidenceAgainst: each documents its own bounds/eviction for a measured reason (settings drops the map, card cache LRU-evicts); merging them would create the generic abstraction the plan forbids; all three are tested including the documented residual window

refactorCandidates.candidate: split a concrete cross-domain responsibility from internal/server
refactorCandidates.evidenceFor: internal/server is 187 production files; the route-domain table already exists
refactorCandidates.evidenceAgainst: no measured coupling or ownership defect has been produced yet; GOAL.md 15.4 forbids rewrites chosen by file size; the ordered-JSON extraction is already refused with a measurement (152 files / 1,463 references)
refactorCandidates.leadDisposition: DECLINE unless a lane produces a measured seam; the source graph is the input to that decision
